stories.title: Raad van State vreest dat volgende generaties rekening betalen, hekelt gebrek aan klimaatbeleid

en.title: Council of State fears next generations will pay the price, criticizes lack of climate policy
en.summary: The Council of State has expressed concern that future generations will bear the costs of inadequate climate policy measures.

stories.title: Oppositie blijft erbij: 'stuurloos' kabinet móét kiezen voor links of rechts

en.title: Opposition remains firm: 'directionless' cabinet must choose left or right
en.summary: Opposition parties say the government's recent policy documents have not convinced them to form a broader parliamentary majority, and they continue demanding the cabinet take a clear political stance.

stories.title: Pro, Ja21 en SGP blijven erbij: kabinet moet kiezen tussen 'links' en 'rechts'

en.title: Pro, JA21 and SGP maintain: cabinet must choose between 'left' and 'right'
en.summary: Major opposition parties see no basis for forming a broad parliamentary majority after the throne speech and budget announcement, with opposition leaders insisting the cabinet must make a clear political choice.

stories.title: Premier Jetten noemt sabotage op treinspoor ‘ontwrichtend en levensgevaarlijk’

en.title: Prime Minister Jetten calls railway track sabotage 'disruptive and life-threatening'
en.summary: The Prime Minister has characterized sabotage on railway tracks as both dangerous to public safety and disruptive to transport infrastructure.

stories.title: Raad van State fel op gebrek aan klimaatplannen: 'Hebben al veel tijd verspild'

en.title: Council of State criticizes lack of climate plans: 'We have already wasted much time'
en.summary: The Dutch Council of State urges the government to accelerate efforts to reduce greenhouse gas emissions to zero in coming decades, warning that waiting until spring to present new plans is inadvisable.

stories.title: Lichaam gevonden bij Arnhem, mogelijk vermiste zanger Ben Saunders

en.title: Body found near Arnhem, possibly missing singer Ben Saunders
en.summary: A body was discovered during a search operation south of Arnhem. The 43-year-old singer Ben Saunders, winner of the first season of The Voice of Holland, had been missing since morning.

stories.title: Rapper Macklemore uit Amerikaanse tournee van ‘apolitieke’ Ed Sheeran gezet na pro-Palestijnse uitspraken

en.title: Rapper Macklemore removed from Ed Sheeran's 'apolitical' American tour following pro-Palestine statements
en.summary: Macklemore was dropped from opening Ed Sheeran's tour after making pro-Palestine remarks, following pressure from American stadium operators regarding his activism.

stories.title: Hooibalen in brand langs verschillende wegen, ME grijpt in bij blokkade N-weg Stroe

en.title: Hay bales burning along various roads, riot police intervene at N-road blockade in Stroe
en.summary: Multiple fires involving hay bales erupted along various highways and main roads across the country on Tuesday afternoon, prompting police and emergency response.

stories.title: Macklemore uit voorprogramma Ed Sheeran geschrapt om pro-Palestijnse uitspraken

en.title: Macklemore removed from Ed Sheeran tour over pro-Palestinian statements
en.summary: American artist Macklemore was dropped from Ed Sheeran's tour due to pro-Palestinian remarks made during performances. Macklemore stated that stadium owners pressured Sheeran to remove him, after performing in only two of ten scheduled opening shows.

stories.title: Koning spreekt in Troonrede hoop uit dat partijen gaan samenwerken: ‘De toekomst wacht niet op achterblijvers’

en.title: King expresses hope in Speech from the Throne that parties will cooperate: 'The future does not wait for stragglers'
en.summary: King Willem-Alexander delivered the Speech from the Throne at the Royal Theater on Prinsjesdag, expressing hope that political parties will work together to address the nation's challenges.

stories.title: Lichaam gevonden in water Arnhem, mogelijk vermiste zanger Ben Saunders (43)

en.title: Body found in water at Arnhem, possibly missing singer Ben Saunders (43)
en.summary: A body was discovered in the Rijkerswoerdse Plassen near Arnhem. The remains are suspected to belong to missing 43-year-old singer Ben Saunders, based on the physical description and presence of his relatives at the location.

stories.title: Koning in troonrede: 'Oplossen problemen kost tijd, niet alles kan tegelijk'

en.title: King in speech from throne: 'Solving problems takes time, not everything can happen at once'
en.summary: King Willem-Alexander emphasized during the Speech from the Throne that resolving political problems in the Netherlands requires time and cannot all be tackled simultaneously.
